description: Put the gloves on, kept the meal to the food, and left Susanna unread.
name: Anne Shakespeare

description: Asked for the death, and was told to finish school.
name: Edmund Shakespeare

description: Followed the spoon's hinge, and left the dying to Edmund.
name: Hamnet Shakespeare

description: Asked about paint, and refused to carry Edmund's ambition to the kitchen.
name: Joan Shakespeare

description: Counted the stitch, recognised his own knee, and did not punish it.
name: John Shakespeare

description: Did her grandfather's walk once, and stopped at the rule she had set.
name: Judith Shakespeare

description: Kept the bread, and did not take a speech.
name: Mary Shakespeare

description: Passed the salt, and said nothing.
name: Richard Shakespeare

description: Sat with yesterday's book, and was not asked to read it out.
name: Susanna Shakespeare

description: Answered Joan, showed the death with a spoon, and sent Edmund back to school.
name: William Shakespeare
